the timing, emplacement, and deformation of a series of basic dykes that are crosscut by the mid-Proterozic Nain Pltutonic Suite (1300-1280 Ma).

the NPS dykes were emplaced between 1328 and 1316 Ma.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the NPS was emplaced in a tectonic setting that involved both extension and contraction, and that the dyke suite was emplaced in response to a combination of extensional and contractional tectonic forces.
the dykes are the result of multiple pulses of magmatism, emplaced over a period of 12 m.y. and that the dyke suite represents a continuum of emplacement styles from granulitic to amphibolite facies.

the Nain Dyke Suite is a product of NPS activity and not an independent event.
the NPS and its associated dykes were emplacing into a tectonically active, ductile, and metamorphosing crust.
